title: Circular Audio Connectors, Part 2: Socket, Five Contacts, Nonrigid Type 12420 IS-01
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 12420 (PART 2)) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Circular Audio Connectors, Part 2: Socket, Five Contacts, Nonrigid Type 12420 IS-01.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
